tools.name: list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the published Malar Park guest rooms with their name, slug, description and nightly price in INR.

limit.description: Maximum number of rooms to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: list_amenities
tools.title: List hotel amenities
tools.description: List the published amenities and facilities offered at Malar Park hotel.

limit.description: Maximum number of amenities to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.title: List FAQs
tools.description: List the published Malar Park frequently asked questions and their answers. Optionally filter by a keyword.

search.description: Optional keyword to match against the question text.

limit.description: Maximum number of FAQs to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.title: List guest reviews
tools.description: List published guest reviews for Malar Park, featured/pinned reviews first, with rating and guest name.

minRating.description: Only return reviews with at least this star rating.

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: list_attractions
tools.title: List nearby attractions
tools.description: List nearby attractions and places of interest around Malar Park in Tiruvannamalai, with distance where available.

limit.description: Maximum number of attractions to return. Defaults to 50.
